steps.say: In Prisoner's Dilemma, you and one or more opponents play multiple rounds against each other. In each round, you choose to cooperate or defect (sell out).

The payoff for each round depends on both players' choices: if both cooperate, you get 3 points each. If both defect, you get 1 point each. If one defects and one cooperates, the defector gets 5 and the cooperator gets 0.
After talking to your opponents, make your secret choice. Your total score is the sum of all rounds against all opponents. The highest total score wins the round-robin.
